pageDescription: J.A.R.V.I.S. — an AI agent platform unifying RAG semantic search, multi-model AI routing, and 30+ automation tool skills.

hero.title: Multi-agent AI assistant
hero.subtitle: Unify RAG semantic search, multi-model AI routing (DeepSeek, Gemini, Claude), and 30+ automation tool skills — all through one natural conversation.

features.title: One platform, three pillars of power
features.subtitle: Built to handle every knowledge task — from internal document lookup to multi-step workflow automation.

rag.title: Hybrid RAG Semantic Search
rag.desc: Search documents and enterprise data with hybrid vector + keyword semantic search, delivering accurate answers with cited sources.

multiAgent.title: Smart Multi-Agent Routing
multiAgent.desc: Automatically routes requests to the best-fit model — DeepSeek, Gemini, or Claude — based on complexity and cost.

toolSkills.title: 30+ Automation Tool Skills
toolSkills.desc: A built-in skill library lets the agent execute tasks on its own: reading files, running code, calling internal APIs, and more.

howItWorks.title: Get started in just 4 steps
howItWorks.subtitle: No complex setup required — sign up and start chatting with your agent right away.

step1.title: Create an account
step1.desc: Sign up for a free J.A.R.V.I.S. account in under a minute.

step2.title: Upload your documents
step2.desc: Connect your internal knowledge base so the agent can answer with the right context.

step3.title: Chat naturally
step3.desc: The agent automatically picks the right AI model and tool skill for each request.

step4.title: Get results & automate
step4.desc: Save the workflow for reuse, saving you time on every future run.

cta.title: Ready for J.A.R.V.I.S. to work alongside you?
cta.subtitle: Join for free today and experience your first multi-agent AI assistant.
